importantFindings.title: Process: a fix for one review finding broke the magic link itself, and no test opened a real sign-in link
importantFindings.evidence: Cleaning ?code from the address (SP-B3-6/FUX-B3-4) ran before the auth client read it, so a valid link signed nobody in; found by the security reviewer (SP-B3-8, round 2). Fixed in 12d9171; b3-backup-ui now opens '/?code=' after sending the link from the same browser and asserts the PKCE exchange.
importantFindings.reproduction: Resolved; the new spec case fails without the fix.

importantFindings.title: Process: two commits were made while verify:quick was failing
importantFindings.evidence: f3a6a3f (a lint error, fixed next commit) and 4dd7977 (timeouts under load while a reviewer drove browsers; the next quiet run passed 1529/1529 with no change). The exit code must be checked before every commit.
importantFindings.reproduction: Resolved; recorded verification is on the final source.

importantFindings.title: The first deferred-reopen design guessed at 'not typing' from focus, which lost a new student on a radio tap and raised a leave guard unasked
importantFindings.evidence: FUX-B3-3 (round 2) and FUX-B3-R2-1. Replaced by a rule that needs no guess: the switch reloads by itself only before the first tap after launch or when asked; otherwise Impostazioni offers Riapri l'app. A tab that performed the switch always reloads, since it can no longer save.
importantFindings.reproduction: b3-backup-ui 'a sign-in finishing while the app is in use never reloads it under the user' (Chromium and WebKit).

qolFindings.title: A signed-in phone whose link was deferred shows 'Backup pronto' only in Impostazioni; Home says nothing
qolFindings.evidence: Seen by the field-UX reviewer in round 3. The case needs a tap during the launch check on a slow connection; the next launch or Riapri l'app completes it.
